races.name: Hartshead Dos Champions Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race) (Div I)

runners_data.name: Rake Lane
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity on debut but highest official rating suggests significant ability if ready to go.
runners_data.comment: Makes belated debut but in modest race and no surprise to see a good run for in-form yard
runners_data.spotlight: 37,000gns foal, 20,000gns yearling; second foal; brother to 7f AW/1m2f turf winner Titainium (RPR 77); dam unraced half-sister to winners Juan Elcano (1m2f Listed) and Nkosikazi (1m2f AW Group 3); makes belated debut but in a modest race and no surprise to see a good run for in-form yard.

runners_data.name: Revolutionelle
runners_data.note: Another newcomer with decent breeding but Haslam's poor recent strike rate is concerning.
runners_data.comment: Market check advised on debut but there's a suspicion this 4yo will be best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to 5.5f-7.5f winner Golden Pharaoh (RPR 83); dam placed 5f/6f (73), out of unraced half-sister to US Horse of the Year Havre De Grace; market check advised on debut but there's a suspicion this 4yo will be best watched.

runners_data.name: Eagle Bay
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who showed promise at Catterick and benefits from Mulrennan's 10-day retain.
runners_data.comment: Promise on sole 2yo start and new trainer has done very well with his family
runners_data.spotlight: Inexperience evident when third of ten at 6-1 at Catterick (7f, good) last October on sole run for Ed Walker; a leading contender if tapping into that promise on this stable and seasonal debut; from a family his new trainer has done very well with.

runners_data.name: Ma Leila
runners_data.note: Only confirmed early pace-setter which gives her tactical advantage despite 185-day absence.
runners_data.comment: Promising 4th on debut last October; failed to back it up in December but not written off
runners_data.spotlight: Promising fourth on debut at Kempton (1m, AW) last October; failed to back that up at Lingfield (1m, AW) in December and absent since; however, she may be able to bounce back with a bold show following a break.

runners_data.name: Kyrenia
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who kept on well at Ripon and benefits from the claim but needs pace to aim at.
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to stable's Kynren; kept on for 3rd on debut and could be sharper for that run
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to the stable's top 7f/1m handicapper Kynren; no match for the winner when 20-1 for recent debut at Ripon (6f, good) but kept on into third and could be sharper for that outing; she's one to consider.

runners_data.name: Brash
runners_data.note: Slowly away on debut but showed some late promise, needs much better start here.
runners_data.comment: Blew the start on debut at Doncaster and did pretty well in the circumstances; chance
runners_data.spotlight: Very slowly away when seventh of ten at 50-1 on recent debut at Doncaster (6f, good); however, in the circumstances he did reasonably well and there's potential in his pedigree; could be a contender if breaking on terms.

runners_data.name: Ice Show
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse dropping in trip after disappointing over longer distances, hard to fancy.
runners_data.comment: Soundly beaten in fifth this spring on first two starts and improvement is needed
runners_data.spotlight: Weak in the market and soundly beaten in fifth this spring on her first two starts (1m/1m1f, AW/good to firm); drops in trip; improvement needed.

runners_data.name: Dolly Golightly
runners_data.note: Well beaten on both starts and hard to see significant improvement coming.
runners_data.comment: Well beaten on both starts, with a long absence in between
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten on 2yo debut at Redcar (5f, good) last April and same story at Catterick (6f, good) a fortnight ago on her sole run since.

runners_data.name: Soda
runners_data.note: Showed promise at Catterick but the drop back to 6f at Ripon didn't suit, needs the longer trip.
runners_data.comment: Green when third over 7f on debut; 6f looked against her latest; might have each-way shout
runners_data.spotlight: Green when third of six on debut at Catterick (7f, good) in April; the drop to 6f looked against her at Ripon (6f, good) next time and she might have an each-way shout back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Circle Of Trust
runners_data.note: Disappointing in handicaps but has previous soft ground form including a nursery second.
runners_data.comment: Disappointing on both starts this season but he's a player on his slow-ground 2yo form
runners_data.spotlight: 0-6 and disappointing in handicaps on both starts this season (7f/6f, good to firm/good); however, she was runner-up in a nursery at Yarmouth (7f, good to soft) last September and it's possible the return to slow ground will trigger a revival; he's a player if so.

races.paceDynamic: Ma Leila will take the field along as the only confirmed pace-setter, likely joined by Revolutionelle if she shows early speed on debut. With just one definite front-runner, the pace will be steady rather than testing, allowing Ma Leila to dictate terms without serious pressure. The field is heavily stacked with hold-up horses (Eagle Bay, Kyrenia, Brash, Ice Show, Dolly Golightly, Soda, Circle Of Trust) who will need the pace to collapse. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners and early pace-setters who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Ma Leila gets an uncontested lead and maintains her early promise
scenarios.body: She can dictate a moderate pace and prove too strong for the hold-up brigade who lack the tactical speed to reel her in. The soft ground will help her stamina and the 7f trip suits her breeding perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Debut Firepower
scenarios.trigger: If either Rake Lane or Revolutionelle shows significant ability on first exposure
scenarios.body: Their higher ratings and superior breeding tell, with fresher legs proving decisive over the more exposed runners. The lightly-raced angle becomes crucial in a weak maiden where experience hasn't translated to success.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and Eagle Bay gets a perfect stalking trip from Mulrennan
scenarios.body: His Catterick third showed genuine promise and he's the pick of the hold-up horses with proven form. Bethell's string have been running well and the step up in trip from his debut could unlock improvement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If Ma Leila goes too fast early trying to make all and weakens in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their preferred scenario with a strong pace to aim at and Kyrenia's staying-on third at Ripon becomes the template. Multiple closers benefit from the tactical meltdown in front.

watchPoints.text: Ma Leila's market support given her tactical advantage and 185-day absence - any drift suggests connections not confident.
How quickly Rake Lane and Revolutionelle break from the stalls on debut - early speed could disrupt the pace scenario.
Eagle Bay's position turning in - if Mulrennan has him handy rather than held up, he becomes a serious threat.
The pace through the first half-mile - if it's crawling, the hold-up horses get their ideal scenario.
Circle Of Trust's early position - Ryan's horses often need the run but she has soft ground form to work with.

races.name: Hartshead Dos Champions Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race) (Div II)

runners_data.name: Leelawadee

runners_data.spotlight: Shaped quite encouragingly at Pontefract last time but has modest RPRs and may be more interesting in handicaps shortly.

races.paceDynamic: Big Shot Veto will lead from the start with no obvious pace rival, allowing him to dictate a comfortable tempo through the early stages. Tip Foster may press from a prominent position, but the majority including Indefensible, Sand Sea, Leelawadee, You Will See and Secretinthesky will settle towards the rear. This creates a scenario where the leader can control fractions without pressure, while the hold-up horses face the challenge of making up significant ground on testing ground. This race shape clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems and the energy-sapping late surge required on soft turf.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Big Shot Veto gets an easy lead and maintains his stamina
scenarios.body: The leader controls every call without pressure and has enough left to repel late challenges on ground that saps closing speed. Front-running tactics prove decisive in a race lacking early pace pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and finishing speed tells
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their turn of foot when it matters most. The lack of early pace creates conditions where class and acceleration can overcome positional disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Tip Foster tracks the leader and times his challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The second-string pace horse benefits from a perfect stalking trip and kicks clear when Big Shot Veto begins to tire. Prominent racing without the full burden of pace-making proves optimal.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and an unconsidered runner finds improvement
scenarios.body: A horse showing hidden ability or significant improvement capitalizes on a tactical race where the favorites cancel each other out. Pace dynamics create opportunities for surprising results.

watchPoints.text: Big Shot Veto could get too easy a lead if no pace pressure develops from the prominent runners
Indefensible's inconsistent nature makes him unreliable despite holding strong RPR credentials
Burrows Silver represents the only newcomer and any market support would be significant
Sand Sea's return after 371 days makes fitness a major question mark despite distance suitability
You Will See needs to prove his Musselburgh flop was just a bad day rather than exposed limitations

races.name: Power Plastics "Big Day Out" Handicap

runners_data.name: Without Flaw
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid 5f form who should avoid the worst traffic from her forward position

runners_data.spotlight: Two of her three wins have come at Beverley (5f, good to firm/soft) and she has dropped back below her last winning mark; ran well on seasonal reappearance at Wetherby (5.5f; third) but had no in-running luck at Beverley subsequently; isn't a forlorn hope.

runners_data.name: Toptime
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner returning from long break but has strong 5f course record when fresh
runners_data.comment: Curled up late when last in action at Southwell (5f) 217 days ago; is positively drawn.

runners_data.name: Zuffolo

runners_data.name: Kyber Crystal

races.paceDynamic: Toptime will lead from the gates and set a sustainable tempo with no genuine speed pressure from the field. Without Flaw, Irish Dancer, Miss Rainbow, Zuffolo and Kyber Crystal will cluster prominently behind the leader, creating a wall of horses 2-3 furlongs from home as they fan out seeking racing room. The lack of early pace means this becomes a sprint from the 2f pole when the prominent pack engages. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can avoid the prominent traffic and deliver late runs down the outside.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prosper
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack creates traffic problems as expected
scenarios.body: The clustered prominent runners get in each other's way turning for home, while patient hold-up horses sweep past down the outside with clear runs. Beerwah and Keep The Gold benefit from their tactical patience and finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front pair dominate finish
scenarios.trigger: If Toptime maintains his lead and Without Flaw breaks clear
scenarios.body: The leader's sustainable gallop sets up perfectly for Without Flaw to challenge and win, with Toptime holding on for second place. Their early positioning avoids all traffic issues.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Irish Dancer times it
scenarios.trigger: If Irish Dancer gets first run from the prominent pack
scenarios.body: His consistent form and tactical speed allows him to quicken first from the congested group, stealing a march before others can respond. Miss Rainbow and Zuffolo follow him through.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Toptime wire to wire
scenarios.trigger: If no horse can match Toptime's sustained gallop
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old's front-running experience proves decisive as he maintains his lead throughout, with the chasing pack arriving too late. Without Flaw runs on for second.

watchPoints.text: Watch for severe traffic problems 2f out when Without Flaw, Irish Dancer, Miss Rainbow, Zuffolo and Kyber Crystal all converge from prominent positions
Monitor Toptime's jumping from the gates as his 217-day break could affect his early alertness
Keep The Gold showed speed before tiring on return at Ayr so fitness improvement expected here
Beerwah's hold-up style gives him the best tactical position to exploit the likely pace scenario
Aurora's Doublesix has failed to beat a rival in her last three starts making her very hard to support

races.paceDynamic: Taygar is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, setting a manageable gallop that he can sustain to the line. With Elvetham likely to sit prominent but no genuine pace pressure expected, the early tempo will be comfortable rather than searching. This creates a race where the front two can control proceedings without being harassed, before the hold-up merchants try to close from the back in the final two furlongs. This tactical shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can position close to Taygar and kick when he weakens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Two Control
scenarios.trigger: If Taygar and Elvetham get soft fractions without pressure from midfield runners.
scenarios.body: The leaders maintain their advantage as hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the testing going. Prominent runners exploit perfect positioning to strike in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with Elvetham pressing Taygar harder than expected.
scenarios.body: The faster tempo sets up perfectly for closers with stamina, allowing them to pick off tiring leaders in the final 100 yards. Fan Mail and Sherlock benefit most from this tactical development.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Taygar Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Taygar gets completely uncontested lead and maintains strong kick despite recent efforts.
scenarios.body: The front runner uses his class edge and race fitness to repel all challenges, holding off late closers through superior conditioning. His prominent style becomes winning front-running in this specific race context.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise From Midfield
scenarios.trigger: If the genuine pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from halfway.
scenarios.body: The tactical race turns into a pure speed test where horses with fresh legs can overcome poor positioning through raw acceleration. East Tyrone's light weight and improved recent form could prove decisive.

watchPoints.text: Taygar must handle being sole pace-setter without burning out in the testing ground
Fan Mail's cheekpieces debut could spark improvement but hold-up style needs pace to develop
East Tyrone carries 18lbs less than top weight and could benefit if pace collapses
Imperial Guard needs the new visor to work immediately given poor trainer record
Elvetham's blinkers and prominent style could prove ideal for controlled pace scenario

races.name: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Handicap

runners_data.name: Myrrh
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won his maiden from behind on soft ground but needs the pace to develop to be effective from his wide draw
runners_data.comment: Hamilton maiden winner (8.5f); twice placed since, including at Doncaster (1m2f) in April.
runners_data.spotlight: Carried persistently left when awarded the race at Hamilton (8.5f, maiden) last September; twice placed since, including when third on handicap debut at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) in April; latest Redcar fourth was broadly similar on RPRs; new trip but considered.

runners_data.name: King Of Berkshire
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with tactical speed who can control the tempo and has winning form over similar distances on testing ground
runners_data.comment: Redcar winner (1m2f); in the mix at Windsor since and this looks a good opportunity.
runners_data.spotlight: Knuckled down to score at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm; 5-6 favourite) on penultimate start and in the mix from this revised mark at Windsor (11.5f; third) subsequently; few concerns about 1m4f around this sharp track, so this looks a good opportunity to add to his tally.

runners_data.name: Rumbustious
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who may need to track King Of Berkshire early but has shown little improvement in four handicap starts this season
runners_data.comment: Lacked the necessary gears when fourth of 11 at Haydock (1m2f; 20-1) latest; new trip.
runners_data.spotlight: Stayed on into third in a Chelmsford maiden (1m2f, AW) in March and again lacked the necessary gears when fourth of 11 at Haydock (1m2f, good to soft; 20-1) a fortnight ago on second handicap start; still unexposed and this extra two furlongs is worth a go.

runners_data.name: Fareenar
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse fitted with tongue-tie whose form has declined since going handicapping and may struggle to get competitive from off the pace
runners_data.comment: Has gone backwards since introduced to tongue-tie and sent handicapping
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in a Redcar novice (1m, good; 16-1) last October but has gone backwards since introduced to a tongue-tie and sent handicapping; 2lb lower than when sixth of nine at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) latest; new trip.

runners_data.name: Wave Power
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who was gelded over winter but has shown little recent improvement and faces a 37-day gap since last run
runners_data.spotlight: Initial promise when a never-nearer fourth to Myrrh at Hamilton (8.5f, soft) last September; gelded over the winter and struggled to get competitive on handicap debut at Southwell (1m3f, AW; 40-1) five weeks ago, beaten over 15l; others are more obvious candidates.

runners_data.name: Forever Perfect
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse better on AW surfaces making turf debut for new connections with limited recent turf form to assess
runners_data.comment: Career best when second to progressive Kakirra (won twice since) at Wolverhampton latest.
runners_data.spotlight: Productive on AW this spring (form figures 3122); career best when runner-up to the progressive Kakirra (won twice since) at Wolverhampton (1m4f; from 2lb lower) four weeks ago; needs to prove herself conclusively on turf but this sharp left-handed track looks suitable.

races.paceDynamic: King Of Berkshire will lead or sit prominent early with Rumbustious likely to track him closely from a forward position. The lack of natural pace setters means King Of Berkshire can dictate at a steady tempo without pressure through the middle stages on the testing ground. Four of the six runners prefer to come from behind (Myrrh, Fareenar, Wave Power, Forever Perfect), creating a tactical imbalance that will leave them with work to do if the pace becomes pedestrian. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure forward positions without expending energy in the early stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Berkshire gets an easy lead with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: The son of Kingman can control the tempo and save energy for a sustained kick, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on soft going from too far back. King Of Berkshire's recent Windsor third suggests he's competitive off this mark when getting his own way.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Rumbustious or another forward runner challenges King Of Berkshire early
scenarios.body: The increased early pace will soften up the leaders and create opportunities for the strong-finishing hold-up horses to close late. Myrrh's maiden win came from behind on soft ground and he could benefit from a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes very slow with no one willing to commit
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the home turn, favouring horses with a turn of foot rather than pure stamina. King Of Berkshire's prominent style still gives him positional advantage but stamina-laden Forever Perfect could struggle in a dash.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground proves more testing than expected and stops the leaders
scenarios.body: The stamina-sapping conditions favour the patient tactics of the hold-up brigade who can grind past tiring leaders. Forever Perfect's recent AW form shows improved fitness despite the surface switch.

watchPoints.text: King Of Berkshire could get an uncontested lead if Rumbustious settles behind him rather than challenging for the early pace
Forever Perfect making switch from all-weather to turf for first time this season with Rebecca Menzies having a quiet spell
Myrrh drawn widest of all in stall 6 which could compromise his hold-up tactics if forced to race too wide
The soft ground may not be testing enough to stop King Of Berkshire if he gets his own way in front
Fareenar wearing tongue-tie but form has gone backwards since the headgear was first applied in recent starts

races.name: David Ritchie Is 50! Happy Birthday! Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Pull The Rug
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with recent good to soft form win, 25 days off track should have him fresh for late surge
runners_data.comment: 1-7; raced wide at Catterick latest and may well come from that reappearance; back to 5f.
runners_data.spotlight: Improved when winning a handicap at Leicester (6f, good to soft) in September but pulled too hard at Newcastle next time; beat only one rival home at Catterick (6f, good) on her reappearance but she raced wide on that occasion and may well come on for it; drop back to 5f should be fine.

runners_data.name: Startling
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but turf record is poor with four AW wins versus zero turf wins in career
runners_data.comment: All four wins have been on the AW; down the field on her stable debut at Redcar last month
runners_data.spotlight: All four wins have been on the AW and she's yet to finish in the first three in four races on turf; pulled up after hitting the gates on her final start for David O'Meara and needs to take a step forward from last month's stable debut.

runners_data.name: Fille Unique
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good form but will face traffic problems with four others wanting same position
runners_data.comment: Off the mark when winning at Musselburgh in April and went close last time; 2lb well in
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the eighth attempt when winning at Musselburgh (5f, good) in April and went close off this mark at Redcar (5f, good to firm) 11 days ago; 2lb well in and has solid claims.

runners_data.name: Dragon Spin
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who made all last time, now 6lb higher but proven at this level
runners_data.comment: Made all at Nottingham last month and now 6lb higher; can give another good account
runners_data.spotlight: Posted some solid efforts in handicaps prior to getting off the mark at Nottingham (5f, good) 27 days ago, making all; now 6lb higher but she's likely to give another good account.

runners_data.name: Thunder Star
runners_data.note: Prominent style but 55 days absence is concerning, headgear change suggests problems
runners_data.comment: Has won five times on turf; failed to beat a rival at Yarmouth latest; switch of headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Has won five times on turf on a variety of ground; did best of her group when ninth of 17 at Doncaster (5f, good to soft) on her return but failed to beat a rival home at Yarmouth 55 days ago; blinkers replace cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Military Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner coming off recent win, 5lb rise manageable given tactical advantage here
runners_data.comment: Built on her return when winning at Ayr last time (good to firm); claims back up 5lb
runners_data.spotlight: Built on her reappearance when beating her five rivals at Ayr (5f, good to firm) 16 days ago; won a maiden on good to soft in 2024 and has claims back up 5lb.

runners_data.name: Tanjen
runners_data.note: Sole front runner gives tactical edge but both wins came on AW, turf record is moderate
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins have been on the AW (2-3 in that sphere); did best of the group of four at Goodwood (5f, good) on her reappearance but failed to back that up at Beverley (5f, good to firm) 24 days ago; needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: J Street
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but limited ability, only win came on soft ground last July
runners_data.comment: 1-13; shaped well at Doncaster in March and another solid effort on the AW last time
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win from 13 starts came in a maiden at Catterick (5f, soft) in July 2024; shaped well when sixth of 17 at Doncaster (5f, good to soft) in March and ran another solid race on the AW at Southwell 15 days ago; contender.

runners_data.name: Data Fata Secutus
runners_data.note: Prominent runner racing yesterday suggests connections confident, but inconsistent recent form
runners_data.comment: Recent efforts suggest that this extra half furlong will be a positive; visored; player.
runners_data.spotlight: Placed at Musselburgh (5f, good) and Redcar (5f, good to firm) in two of her four starts on turf this season; not so good in the other two, however, and she weakened tamely when a visor was added at Wetherby on Thursday.

runners_data.name: Star Marian
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner better needed back on turf after two AW handicap failures
runners_data.comment: Made all in a maiden at Wolverhampton in March but well held in two AW handicaps since
runners_data.spotlight: Made all in a maiden at Wolverhampton (5f, AW) in March but she's been well held in two handicaps since; better needed back on turf.

runners_data.name: Solid Bond
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 221-day absence after wind operation, fitness major doubt
runners_data.comment: Placed twice at novice level but didn't progress in handicaps; wind operation since
runners_data.spotlight: Placed twice at novice level, including on soft ground over this C&D on her debut, but wasn't able to progress in handicaps last year; has had a wind operation since last seen 221 days ago and she's best watched unless the market speaks favourably.

runners_data.name: Cheerleader
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 291-day layoff, previous course and distance form gives slight hope
runners_data.comment: Won twice last May but didn't beat a rival when last seen 291 days ago; wind operation
runners_data.spotlight: Won her first two starts for this yard at Redcar (good to firm) and Catterick (good to soft) last May, but she was last of eight at the latter track when last seen 291 days ago; has since had wind surgery.

races.paceDynamic: Tanjen is the sole dedicated front runner and will have an easy lead in the early stages. Five horses (Fille Unique, Dragon Spin, Thunder Star, J Street, Data Fata Secutus) want prominent positions, creating significant congestion and traffic problems 2-3 furlongs out on this sharp 5f track. The hold-up horses (Pull The Rug, Military Girl, Star Marian) will have clean runs from the back as the pace battle unfolds ahead. This shape strongly favours the hold-up runners who can exploit the prominent traffic jam and Tanjen's likely vulnerability to late challengers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack creates the expected traffic chaos approaching the final 2f
scenarios.body: The hold-up runners get clear runs while the prominent group gets shuffled and blocked, allowing the back markers to pick them off in the final furlong. Military Girl and Pull The Rug are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Escape Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If one or two of the prominent runners avoid the congestion and get first run
scenarios.body: Dragon Spin or Fille Unique break clear from the pack before the traffic develops, using their early positioning advantage to hold off late challengers. Their recent form suggests they can capitalize if getting a clear passage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tanjen Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the lone leader gets soft fractions and kicks clear 2f out
scenarios.body: Without early pace pressure, Tanjen controls the race and has enough left to resist the late challenge, using her tactical advantage to maximum effect. Her front-running style becomes an asset rather than a liability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Helps Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the field comes together in a bunched finish
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows every horse a chance and one of the outsiders sneaks through the gaps created by the prominent congestion. Thunder Star or Solid Bond could benefit from their racing experience in such scenarios.

watchPoints.text: Fille Unique, Dragon Spin, Thunder Star, J Street and Data Fata Secutus will create a five-horse pile-up approaching the 2f marker
Tanjen gets uncontested lead but may not have the stamina to resist late challengers on turf
Military Girl dropping back from prominent position could signal confidence in her finishing kick
Solid Bond and Cheerleader both returning from long absences may need the run fitness-wise
Pull The Rug's tendency to pull hard could work in his favour if getting cover in the early stages

races.name: Next Meeting Tuesday 16th June Featuring Royal Ascot Handicap

runners_data.name: Real Jack
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner needs strong pace and luck in running, 29 days off could leave him short
runners_data.comment: Runner-up at Newcastle in November; ran to a similar level in both starts this year (AW)
runners_data.spotlight: 0-5 but runner-up in a novice at Newcastle (5f, AW) in November; midfield finish on handicap debut at Southwell (6f, AW) in April and ran to a similar level there (7f) four weeks ago; drops back in trip on this return to turf.

runners_data.name: Brave Traveller
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader with recent form edge, gelding operation may have sharpened him up
runners_data.comment: Won at Newcastle in December and went close there last time after being gelded; contender
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 6f nursery at Newcastle in December and went close there last time over 5f on his first start since being gelded; steps back up in trip and returns to turf; can make his presence felt.

runners_data.name: Empress Olivia
runners_data.note: Previous C&D winner on similar going, prominent style suits likely pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Both wins over 6f at Ripon; possibly wasn't helped by track position at Ascot last time
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins have been over 6f at Ripon, the most recent in April on good to soft off 4lb lower than today; led a smaller group of five when 11th at Ascot (6f, good) 28 days ago but looks capable of bouncing back.

runners_data.name: Bye Law
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who hasn't recaptured juvenile form, needs everything to fall right
runners_data.comment: Won a Ayr maiden and Redcar novice last summer but hasn't matched that level since
runners_data.spotlight: Won Ayr maiden and Redcar novice (6f, good/good to firm) last summer but he hasn't matched that level in handicaps since; never-dangerous sixth of 14 at Beverley (5f, good to soft) last month but well held over 7f at York 13 days ago; drops back to 6f with a place squeak.

runners_data.name: Showtown
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who shaped better last time, cheekpieces retained from debut
runners_data.comment: Ran better at Haydock last time than he did on his handicap debut; better is still needed
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field on his handicap debut at Beverley (5f, good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) last month but ran a bit better when fourth of 11 at Haydock (6f, soft) 15 days ago; better still needed.

runners_data.name: Logi Bear
runners_data.note: Struggling since yard switch, hold-up style needs strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Sole win came at Newmarket last May; not threatened in two starts since joining stable
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win from 12 starts came for Richard Hannon at Newmarket (6f, good) last May; struggled on his last few starts for that stable and he's not threatened in his two outings since joining this yard; dropped another 3lb.

runners_data.name: Napolian
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from 253-day break, fitness major concern despite workmanlike style
runners_data.comment: 0-4; below his best at Pontefract when last seen 253 days ago and has since been gelded
runners_data.spotlight: 0-4 but he did finish in the first three in each of his first three starts, including over C&D in August; below his best at Pontefract (6f, good to soft) when last seen 253 days ago and has since been gelded; handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Von Trotter
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping back onto turf, struggled when stepped up in class last time
runners_data.comment: Second in his first three starts (AW) but well beaten on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Second in his first three starts (6f/5f, AW) but finished down the field in a competitive race at York (5f, good) on his handicap and turf debut three weeks ago; steps back up in trip and drops in grade.

runners_data.name: Daizen
runners_data.note: Proven on soft ground with tactical speed, disappointed since winning maiden
runners_data.comment: Sole win came in a soft-ground maiden at Ayr; a bit better than the bare result last time
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win from nine starts came in a maiden at Ayr (6f, soft) in September; below that level since but he shaped a bit better than the bare result at Haydock (6f, soft) 15 days ago; each-way chance.

runners_data.name: Perineighs
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 219-day absence, trip drop may help but fitness doubtful
runners_data.comment: Solid effort when third on her handicap debut at Nottingham (5f) in October; back up to 6f
runners_data.spotlight: Five-race maiden but she posted a solid effort when third of nine on her handicap debut at Nottingham (5f, soft) in October; off since but should be suited by the step back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Different Opinions
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making handicap debut with visor fitted, underwhelming since promising debut
runners_data.comment: Promising second on his debut in March but hasn't progressed; visor now added
runners_data.spotlight: Promising second on his debut at Chelmsford (7f, AW) in March but he's not progressed in three starts since, including over this trip at Ripon in April; makes his handicap debut with a visor now applied.

runners_data.name: Uncertainty
runners_data.note: Maiden struggling since yard switch, hold-up style poorly suited to likely pace
runners_data.comment: 0-9; struggled in three starts since joining this stable (1m/6f) and has a bit to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Nine-race maiden who was runner-up at Lingfield (7f, AW) on her final outing for Richard Hannon; however, she's struggled in three starts for this yard (1m/6f) and has a bit to prove.

runners_data.name: Hvar
runners_data.note: Inconsistent since winning novice, prominent style gives him a chance if reproducing best form
runners_data.comment: Won a 6f novice on the AW for Ralph Beckett; struggled in handicaps for this stable
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt when winning a novice at Wolverhampton (6f) in October on his final start for Ralph Beckett, but he's struggled in three handicaps since joining this stable; others have stronger claims.

races.paceDynamic: Napolian and Brave Traveller will ensure a proper gallop from the start, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. Showtown, Von Trotter, Empress Olivia and Daizen should sit prominent just behind the leaders, creating a strong pace through the first half of this 6f contest. The honest tempo will stretch the field and expose any stamina limitations on the soft ground. This race shape strongly favors prominent runners and those with tactical pace to position close to the speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Strong Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If both Napolian and Brave Traveller go hard from the gate and maintain a strong tempo
scenarios.body: The relentless pace will suit those sitting handy who can quicken off it, particularly horses proven on soft ground. Empress Olivia and Showtown are best positioned to benefit from this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either Napolian or Brave Traveller gets an uncontested lead while the other settles
scenarios.body: The lone leader gets first run and the pace becomes more tactical, suiting the horse with the clearest run. Brave Traveller's recent form edge gives him the advantage in a pace duel.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses mid-race and the prominent runners take over
scenarios.body: Those sitting in the second rank can organize a sustained drive that leaves the leaders vulnerable. Von Trotter and Daizen have the tactical speed to capitalize when the race opens up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Kick Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong and the field spreads out significantly
scenarios.body: Patient tactics pay off as the early speed falters, allowing closers to pick up the pieces late. Real Jack and Uncertainty need this exact scenario to be competitive.

watchPoints.text: Napolian's 253-day layoff is a major fitness concern for a horse needing to battle for the early lead
Von Trotter drops back to turf after AW success but struggled badly when facing stronger competition at York
Brave Traveller benefits from recent gelding operation and could have improved significantly
Several hold-up runners including Real Jack and Perineighs face fitness questions after extended breaks
Empress Olivia's previous course and distance win on similar going makes her a logical pace beneficiary
